entries.title: Oxygen Not Included
entries.definitive_edition: Oxygen Not Included on Windows PC with the gameplay DLC packs

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Current PC release with gameplay DLC through The Aquatic Planet Pack
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the most straightforward current route for the base game and all gameplay DLC, with the best capture/settings support. macOS and Linux are useful native routes, but Windows PC remains the primary support/capture target.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam or Epic Games Store. For the complete gameplay route, add Spaced Out!, The Frosty Planet Pack, The Bionic Booster Pack, The Prehistoric Planet Pack, and The Aquatic Planet Pack; cosmetic packs are optional.

entries.remaster_caveats: Spaced Out! and the planet/booster packs are DLC, not separate game entries. The Neutronium Cosmetics Pack is cosmetic and optional for gameplay completeness.
